- Timeline: pilot active now -> committed purchase decision in ~60–90 days

Hi Emily — congrats on Skyline, and welcome.

Short answer: yes — we can usually provide a short-term bridge, but there are some constraints around stacking and approvals. High-level options I can offer quickly:

- Standard startup package: $25,000 promo credits (6 months) — this is our usual accelerator grant.
- One-time bridge/top-up: up to $10,000 in additional credits for 60–90 days (requires promo-exception approval).
- Sandbox allowance: temporary reduced-cost sandbox (no SLA) for 90 days to cover peak early testing.

Constraints and ask:
- We generally do not stack multiple open promos; a bridge can be approved as an exception if the customer commits to a follow-on reserved plan (Dedicated) or a minimum hosted spend.
- For a bridge approval I need: expected token profile (quick breakdown), target commit after trial (estimated $/month), and a PO or written intent to commit.

Suggested path for speed: I can send a bridge offer (draft promo-exception) for internal signoff and then a formal bridge offer for you to sign (DocuSign). Attached is a draft for internal review (promo-exception-draft.docx).

Can you send the short token profile and confirm whether you can commit to a $5k/month minimum on Dedicated or hosted API after the pilot? If that works we can fast-track the $10k bridge.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Sales Manager, Startup Programs
Redwood Inference

Vanessa / Marissa — quick internal notes on the exception:

- If we approve $10k bridge on top of the $25k promo credits, expected gross overdraft cost (GOC) at current cost model is roughly $4k for the pilot window. That leaves small incremental margin if we convert to a committed $5k/mo Dedicated plan.
- Alternative we should consider: 90-day sandbox allowance (no SLA) + 20% off committed pricing for the first 6 months post-conversion. This reduces short-term cash exposure and gives the customer time to procure.

Recommendation: approve bridge up to $10k if customer agrees to: 1) sign the bridge offer, 2) provide a PO for the committed plan within 45 days, and 3) convert to at least $5k/mo for 6 months — otherwise credits expire.

Attaching a quick margin calc (margin-calc.csv). I'll join the call if needed.

Ben
Director, Startup Partnerships

Emily — thanks for the details on the call earlier. Attached is the formal bridge offer (bridge-offer.pdf). Summary of the offer below — please review and confirm by replying with approval or send back a PO:

Bridge Package (VentureKit / DK-3921) — summary:
- Startup grant: $25,000 in promo credits (standard)
- Bridge/top-up: $10,000 in bridge credits (one-time) valid for 90 days from date of activation
- Sandbox allowance: access to sandbox pool with reduced cost profile for up to 90 days (no uptime SLA)
- Post-pilot commitment: Customer to convert to Dedicated or Hosted committed plan of at least $5,000/month for a minimum of 6 months.
- Conversion discount: 15% off list for the first 6 months after conversion (applies to committed monthly bill).
- Conditions: Bridge credits cannot be combined with other active promo credits unless explicitly approved; credits expire if conversion conditions are not met.

Next steps:
1) Reply to this thread confirming you accept the above terms (we will then issue the DocuSign).
2) Provide a draft PO if procurement requires one — we can incorporate billing/contact details.

If you need any changes (start date shift, different commit), flag it here and I will run the exception path — timeline for approvals is typically 24–48 hours for standard exceptions.

Thanks and looking forward — happy to hop on another quick call if Rajiv wants to talk throughput or KV cache sizing for embeddings.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
